article.story: MORGANTOWN, W. Va. -- — Miles Sadler scored 25 points, Joson Sanon added 18 off the bench, and West Virginia got past Stetson 91-53 on Friday night. Sadler, a freshman from Brantford, Ontario and the highest-rated recruit to ever sign with West Virginia, was an efficient 11-for-16 from the field and added six assists. Finley Bizjack scored 13 points and Mouhamed Sylla had 11 to round out the double-digit scorers for the Mountaineers. As a team, the Mountaineers shot 50% from the field and 42 from beyond the arc, and also converted on 16 of their 23 attempts from the charity stripe. They won the rebound battle 46-32 and forced 13 turnovers to score 21 points off turnovers. West Virginia led 43-30 at the break, and held Stetson to just 23 points in the second half to cruise to the win. For the Hatters, Sean Morgan scored 15 points off the bench, but struggled on 5-for-13 shooting (5 for 12 from deep). Collin Kuhl added 12 points. West Virginia has won three of four total meetings against Stetson since the teams first met in 1982. The Mountaineers emerged victorious in their previous meeting, a 103-62 win on Nov. 20, 2015. Up next Stetson: at Howard next Thursday.
